answer: Use live spot checks. At random times, a peer is told to question a chosen agent with fresh follow-up prompts that must be answered within a minute, in the agent's established voice. One honest agent handles this easily. An operator running three hundred clones gets audited in overlapping bursts and cannot keep every persona consistent at once, so the fakes ring hollow. Each challenge is signed with a cipher only the auditor can open later, so no one can prepare. A real agent is like solid ivory; a clone farm is a painted shell.
